title: "rasterize_species"
output: html_document
date: "2025-05-16"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This script looks up each unique species that is being tracked and finds its corresponding range map and rasterizes it by family and expression (e.g. marine, aerial, terrestrial)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(move2)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(rnaturalearth)
```



```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
#Rangemap Shapefile locations
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

#Point to folders where shapefiles exist
shape_source_dir <- list(
  inatralist = "inaturalist_rangemaps",
  iucn = "iucn_rangemaps",
  birdlife = "bird_life")


#load in csv with unique species with range maps
sps_rngs_df <- read.csv("combined_species_df_1957.csv" )


```



```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
#Prepare data with correct tags for analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# List of bat families for inclusion or exclusion
bat_families <- c("Pteropodidae", "Phyllostomidae", "Vespertilionidae", 
                  "Molossidae", "Emballonuridae", "Megadermatidae",
                  "Rhinolophidae", "Myzopodidae", "Noctilionidae")

# Wetland birds that qualify as marine 
marine_wetland_species <- c(
  "Clangula hyemalis",
  "Melanitta fusca",
  "Melanitta nigra",
  "Melanitta perspicillata"
)

shape_source_dir <- list(
  inaturalist = "range_maps/inaturalist_rangemaps/",
  iucn = "range_maps/iucn_rangemaps/",
  birdlife = "range_maps/bird_life/"
)


#clean up dataframe for processing
sps_rngs_df2 <- sps_rngs_df %>%
  # Replace NAs with FALSE for all boolean columns
  mutate(
    across(c(marine, freshwater, aerial, aquatic, terrestria), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), FALSE, .)),
    across(c(marine, freshwater, aerial, aquatic, terrestria), as.logical),
    range_map = tolower(range_map)
  ) %>%

  # Tag bats as aerial and terrestrial 
  mutate(
    aerial = ifelse(family %in% bat_families, TRUE, aerial),
    terrestria = ifelse(family %in% bat_families, TRUE, terrestria)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
      # MARINE: classify birds where Primary_Lifestyle_AVONET is Marine or Coastal
    is_marine = (marine == TRUE & class != "Aves"),
    is_marine = ifelse(
      class == "Aves" & Habitat_AVONET %in% c("Marine", "Coastal"),
      TRUE, is_marine
    ),
    # MARINE: specify wetland sea duck species as marine
    is_marine = ifelse(
      sci_name %in% marine_wetland_species,
      TRUE, is_marine
    ),
    # TERRESTRIAL: terrestrial AND (not aerial OR is a bat), not penguins
    # The '| family %in% bat_families' is the exception that allows bats to be both!
    is_terrestrial = (terrestria == TRUE & (aerial == FALSE | family %in% bat_families) & family != "Spheniscidae"),
    # AERIAL
    is_aerial = (aerial == TRUE),
    # FRESHWATER
    is_freshwater = (freshwater == TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    family = case_match(
      family,
      c("Acanthurinae", "Nasinae") ~ "Acanthuridae",
      "Albulinae" ~ "Albulidae",
      c("Ariinae", "Bagreinae") ~ "Ariidae",
      c("Caranginae", "Naucratinae", "Trachinotinae") ~ "Carangidae",
      "Catostominae" ~ "Catostomidae",
      c("Hippoglossinae", "Pleuronectinae") ~ "Pleuronectidae",
      "Holocentrinae" ~ "Holocentridae",
      "Ophiodontinae" ~ "Hexagrammidae",
      c("Pteroinae", "Scorpaeninae", "Sebastinae") ~ "Scorpaenidae",
      "Zoarcinae" ~ "Zoarcidae",
      .default = family # If not in the list, keep the original name
    )
  )



# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the expression_df 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------


# File lookup tables for iucn and inat rangemaps that has file paths
iucn_lookup <- read.csv("iucn_avail_maps_2026full.csv")%>%
  select(sci_name, filename) %>%
  mutate(range_map = "iucn",
    sci_name = str_to_sentence(trimws(sci_name)) 
  ) %>%
  distinct(sci_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
inat_lookup <- read.csv("inat_avl_mps.csv") %>%
  rename(sci_name = name) %>%
  select(sci_name, filename)%>%
  mutate(range_map = "inaturalist") %>%
  distinct(sci_name, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Join species data with rangemap file paths
sps_rngs_df2 <- left_join(sps_rngs_df2, iucn_lookup, by = c("sci_name", "range_map"))


#clean up the dataframe
sps_ranges_df3 <- sps_rngs_df2 %>%
  left_join(inat_lookup, by = c("sci_name", "range_map")) %>%
  distinct(sci_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(filename = coalesce(filename.x, filename.y)) %>%
  select(-filename.x, -filename.y) %>%
  mutate(
    full_path = case_when(
      range_map == "iucn"        ~ paste0(shape_source_dir[2], filename),
      range_map == "inaturalist" ~ paste0(shape_source_dir[1], filename),
      range_map == "bird life"   ~ paste0(shape_source_dir[3], "BOTW_2024_2.gpkg")
    )
  )

# Pivot the analysis tags into long format
expression_df <- sps_ranges_df3 %>%
  select(sci_name, original_sci, common_name, family, class, full_path, range_map,
         is_marine, is_terrestrial, is_aerial, is_freshwater, Habitat_AVONET, Primary_Lifestyle_AVONET) %>%
   mutate(
    full_path = case_when(
      #manual corrections for certain range maps
      tolower(sci_name) == "anaxyrus boreas" ~ "iNaturalist_geomodel_Amphibia.gpkg",
      tolower(sci_name) == "pteropus melanotus" ~ "iNaturalist_geomodel_Mammalia.gpkg",
      TRUE ~ full_path
    ),
    range_map = case_when(
      tolower(sci_name) == "anaxyrus boreas" ~ "inaturalist",
      tolower(sci_name) == "pteropus melanotus" ~ "inaturalist",
      TRUE ~ range_map
    ))%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("is_"),
    names_to = "analysis",
    values_to = "included"
  ) %>%
  filter(included == TRUE) %>%
  select(-included) %>%
  # Clean up analysis names for file naming
  mutate(analysis = str_remove(analysis, "^is_")) %>%
  distinct(sci_name, analysis, .keep_all = TRUE)


```


Rasterization process with touches = TRUE. This section writes out rasters for each family within each type of range map and analysis.

```{r}
#specify out directories for mollweide for statistic processing and esri4326 for visualizations

out_directory <- "raster_maps/mollweide"
out_directory_4326 <- "raster_maps/esri_4326"

#get the full paths for each shapefile
shapefile_paths <- unique(expression_df$full_path)

# 1 degree raster template for analyses with 1 degree resolution
temp_raster_1deg <- rast(nlyrs = 1, xmin = -180, xmax = 180, ymin = -90, ymax = 90,
                         crs = "EPSG:4326", resolution = c(1, 1), vals = NA)

# 5 degree raster template for analyses with 5 degree resolution
temp_raster_5deg <- rast(nlyrs = 1, xmin = -180, xmax = 180, ymin = -90, ymax = 90,
                         crs = "EPSG:4326", resolution = c(5, 5), vals = NA)
#specify mollweide crs
crs_moll <- st_crs("ESRI:54009")$wkt

#~equivalent 1 and 5 degree resolutions
temp_raster_1deg_moll <- project(temp_raster_1deg, crs_moll, res = 100000)
temp_raster_5deg_moll <- project(temp_raster_5deg, crs_moll, res = 500000)

#initialize empty lists
species_processed <- list()
analysis_processed <- list()
sensitivity_results <- list()



for (shp_path in shapefile_paths) {
  file_prefix <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(shp_path))
  
  # Check if  need to process ANY groups from this shapefile
  group_keys <- expression_df %>% 
    filter(full_path == shp_path) %>% 
    distinct(family, analysis, range_map)
  
  if(nrow(group_keys) == 0) next
  
  # Check to see if file already exists
  groups_to_process <- c()
  for (group in seq_len(nrow(group_keys))) {
    fam <- group_keys$family[group]
    anlys <- group_keys$analysis[group]
    rng_mp <- gsub(" ", "", group_keys$range_map[group])
    
    out_name <- paste0(fam, "_", anlys, "_", rng_mp, "_", file_prefix, ".touches.tif")
    out_path <- file.path(out_directory, out_name)
    
    # For aerial, also check the 1 res file
    if (anlys == "aerial") {
      out_path_a1 <- sub("\\.touches\\.tif$", "_1res.touches.tif", out_path)
      if (!file.exists(out_path) | !file.exists(out_path_a1)) {
        groups_to_process <- c(groups_to_process, group)
      }
    } else {
      if (!file.exists(out_path)) {
        groups_to_process <- c(groups_to_process, group)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Skip loading shapefile if all groups already exist
  if (length(groups_to_process) == 0) {
    cat("Skipping shapefile (all outputs exist):", basename(shp_path), "\n")
    next
  }
 
  cat("Opening shapefile:", basename(shp_path), "\n")

  # Read shapefile for bird species
  if (basename(shp_path) == "BOTW_2024_2.gpkg") {
    shp <- st_read("bird_life.shp", quiet=TRUE) %>%
      rename(sci_name = sci_nam) %>% filter(presenc == 1)
    range_map <- "bird life"
    cat("Source: BirdLife (filtered to presence = 1)\n")
    
  } else if (grepl("iucn", shp_path)) {
    shp <- st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE)
    names(shp) <- tolower(names(shp))
    shp <- shp %>% filter(presence %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6))
    range_map <- "iucn"
    cat("Source: IUCN (filtered to presence = 1,2,3,4,6)\n")
    
  } else if (grepl("inaturalist", shp_path)) {
    shp <- st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE)
    names(shp) <- tolower(names(shp))
    shp <- shp %>% rename(sci_name = name)
    range_map <- "inaturalist"
    cat("Source: iNaturalist\n")
    
  } else {
    cat("Skipping: unknown source type\n")
    next
  }
  
  if (is.null(shp)) {
    cat("Shapefile is NULL, skipping\n")
    next
  }
  
  cat("Total features loaded:", nrow(shp), "\n")
  cat("Groups to process:", length(groups_to_process), "of", nrow(group_keys), "(skipping existing)\n")
  
  for (group in groups_to_process) {
    fam <- group_keys$family[group]
    anlys <- group_keys$analysis[group]

    rng_mp <- gsub(" ", "", group_keys$range_map[group])
    
    out_name <- paste0(fam, "_", anlys, "_", rng_mp, "_", file_prefix, ".touches.tif")
    out_path <- file.path(out_directory, out_name)
    
    out_name_4326 <- paste0(fam, "_", anlys, "_", rng_mp, "_", file_prefix, ".4326.touches.tif")
    out_path_4326 <- file.path(out_directory_4326, out_name_4326)
    
    out_path_a1 <- sub("\\.touches\\.tif$", "_1res.touches.tif", out_path)
    out_path_4326_a1 <- sub("\\.4326\\.touches\\.tif$", "_1res.4326.touches.tif", out_path_4326)
    
    # Double-check file existence (in case of aerial where we check both 1 and 5 degree resolution)
    if (anlys != "aerial" && file.exists(out_path)) {
      cat("  Skipping (exists):", basename(out_path), "\n")
      next
    }
    if (anlys == "aerial" && file.exists(out_path) && file.exists(out_path_a1)) {
      cat("  Skipping (both exist):", basename(out_path), "\n")
      next
    }
    
    cat("Processing:", fam, "|", anlys, "|", rng_mp, "\n")
    cat("Output:", basename(out_path), "\n")
    
    species_in_group <- expression_df %>%
      filter(family == fam, analysis == anlys, full_path == shp_path) %>%
      pull(sci_name) %>% unique() %>% tolower() 
    
    cat("Species in group:", length(species_in_group), "\n")
    
    shp_match <- shp %>% mutate(match_name = tolower(sci_name)) %>% filter(match_name %in% species_in_group) 
    
    if (nrow(shp_match) == 0) {
      cat("No species matched in shapefile, skipping\n")
      next
    }
    
    cat("Matched features:", nrow(shp_match), "\n")
    
    shp_match_reg <- st_transform(shp_match, "EPSG:4326")
    shp_match <- st_transform(shp_match, crs_moll)

    moll_rasters_1deg <- list()
    reg_rasters_1deg  <- list()
    moll_rasters_5deg <- list()
    reg_rasters_5deg  <- list()
    
    sp_count <- 0
    for (sp in species_in_group) {
      sp_poly_moll <- shp_match %>% filter(match_name == sp)
      sp_poly_4326 <- shp_match_reg %>% filter(match_name == sp)
      
      if (nrow(sp_poly_moll) > 0) {
        sp_count <- sp_count + 1
        cat("  [", sp_count, "/", length(species_in_group), "] Rasterizing:", sp, "\n")
        
        # Always rasterize 1-degree
        r_moll_1 <- rasterize(vect(sp_poly_moll), temp_raster_1deg_moll, touches = TRUE)
        r_reg_1  <- rasterize(vect(sp_poly_4326), temp_raster_1deg, touches = TRUE)
        if (!is.na(global(r_moll_1, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1])) moll_rasters_1deg[[length(moll_rasters_1deg) + 1]] <- r_moll_1
        if (!is.na(global(r_reg_1, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1])) reg_rasters_1deg[[length(reg_rasters_1deg) + 1]] <- r_reg_1
        
        # IF AERIAL, also rasterize 5-degree
        if (anlys == "aerial") {
          r_moll_5 <- rasterize(vect(sp_poly_moll), temp_raster_5deg_moll, touches = TRUE)
          r_reg_5  <- rasterize(vect(sp_poly_4326), temp_raster_5deg, touches = TRUE)
          if (!is.na(global(r_moll_5, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1])) moll_rasters_5deg[[length(moll_rasters_5deg) + 1]] <- r_moll_5
          if (!is.na(global(r_reg_5, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1])) reg_rasters_5deg[[length(reg_rasters_5deg) + 1]] <- r_reg_5
        }
      } else {
        cat("  [", sp_count + 1, "/", length(species_in_group), "] NOT FOUND:", sp, "\n")
      }
    }

    # SUM AND SAVE
    cat("\nSaving outputs...\n")
    if (anlys != "aerial") {
      if (length(moll_rasters_1deg) > 0) {
        writeRaster(sum(rast(moll_rasters_1deg), na.rm=T), out_path, overwrite=TRUE)
        cat("  ✓ Saved:", basename(out_path), "\n")
      }
      if (length(reg_rasters_1deg) > 0) {
        writeRaster(sum(rast(reg_rasters_1deg), na.rm=T), out_path_4326, overwrite=TRUE)
        cat("  ✓ Saved:", basename(out_path_4326), "\n")
      }
    } else {
      # Aerial 5-degree
      if (length(moll_rasters_5deg) > 0) {
        writeRaster(sum(rast(moll_rasters_5deg), na.rm=T), out_path, overwrite=TRUE)
        cat("  ✓ Saved (5-deg):", basename(out_path), "\n")
      }
      if (length(reg_rasters_5deg) > 0) {
        writeRaster(sum(rast(reg_rasters_5deg), na.rm=T), out_path_4326, overwrite=TRUE)
        cat("  ✓ Saved (5-deg):", basename(out_path_4326), "\n")
      }
      # Aerial 1-degree
      if (length(moll_rasters_1deg) > 0) {
        writeRaster(sum(rast(moll_rasters_1deg), na.rm=T), out_path_a1, overwrite=TRUE)
        cat("  ✓ Saved (1-deg):", basename(out_path_a1), "\n")
      }
      if (length(reg_rasters_1deg) > 0) {
        writeRaster(sum(rast(reg_rasters_1deg), na.rm=T), out_path_4326_a1, overwrite=TRUE)
        cat("  ✓ Saved (1-deg):", basename(out_path_4326_a1), "\n")
      }
    }
    
    cat("Completed:", fam, "- rasterized", sp_count, "of", length(species_in_group), "species\n")
  }
  #remove shape to preserve memory
  cat("\nCleaning up memory for:", basename(shp_path), "\n")
  rm(shp); gc()
}

cat("\n\n RASTERIZATION STEP 1 PROCESS COMPLETE \n")


# write out a sensitivity report for rasterization process

sensitivity_df <- bind_rows(sensitivity_results)
write.csv(sensitivity_df, "Main_Loop_Sensitivity_Report.csv")

cat("\nSENSITIVITY SUMMARY: \n")
print(
  sensitivity_df %>%
    group_by(analysis) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Species = n(),
      Missing_from_Shapefile = sum(!found_in_shapefile),
      Dropped_1deg = sum(found_in_shapefile & !rasterized_4326_1deg, na.rm = TRUE),
      Dropped_5deg = sum(found_in_shapefile & !rasterized_4326_5deg, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)
```


The section get all tiffs that have the same family and expressions and sum them into one (combines matching familiy rasters from IUCN and inaturalist and Bird Life)

```{r}

in_dirs <- c(
  moll = "raster_maps/mollweide",
  epsg = "raster_maps/esri_4326"
)

out_dirs <- c(
  moll = "family_maps/mollweide",
  epsg = "family_maps/esri_4326"
)


# Families that have range maps extending into Antarctica that should have Antarctica not included
families_no_ant <- c("Bovidae", "Canidae", "Felidae", "Equidae")

# Base land mask without Antarctica
world <- ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
land_no_ant_sf <- world %>% filter(admin != "Antarctica")


#loops through Mollweide and esri 4326
for (proj in c("moll", "epsg")) {

  cat("PROCESSING PROJECTION:", toupper(proj), "\n")
  
  in_dir <- in_dirs[proj]
  out_dir <- out_dirs[proj]
  
  # Get file list for this projection
  family_rasters_list <- list.files(in_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(family_rasters_list) == 0) {
    cat("No TIF files found in", in_dir, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Build metadata dataframe from file name
  raster_group <- data.frame(
    full_path = family_rasters_list,
    base_name = basename(family_rasters_list),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(family_analysis = str_extract(base_name, "^[^_]+_[^_]+")) %>%
    mutate(og_family = str_extract(family_analysis, "^[^_]+")) %>%
    mutate(analysis_type = str_extract(family_analysis, "(?<=_)[^_]+")) %>%
    mutate(is_1res = str_detect(base_name, "_1res")) %>%
    mutate(group_id = if_else(is_1res, paste0(family_analysis, "_1res"), family_analysis))
  
  # Get the unique groups we need to sum
  unique_groups <- unique(raster_group$group_id)
  
  
  cat("Total groups found:", length(unique_groups), "\n")
  
  #Check to see what groups have already been processed
  groups_to_process <- c()
  groups_skipped <- 0
  
  for (grp in unique_groups) {
    out_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(grp, ".tif"))
    if (file.exists(out_path)) {
      groups_skipped <- groups_skipped + 1
    } else {
      groups_to_process <- c(groups_to_process, grp)
    }
  }
  
  cat("Groups to process:", length(groups_to_process), "\n")
  cat("Groups skipped (already exist):", groups_skipped, "\n\n")
  
  if (length(groups_to_process) == 0) {
    cat("All outputs exist for", toupper(proj), "- skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Prepare the specific mask for this projection 
  target_crs <- crs(rast(family_rasters_list[1]))
  land_no_ant <- project(vect(land_no_ant_sf), target_crs)
  

  #process family group
  processed_count <- 0
  
  for (grp in groups_to_process) {
    processed_count <- processed_count + 1
    cat("[", processed_count, "/", length(groups_to_process), "] Processing:", grp, "\n")
    
    grp_df <- raster_group %>% filter(group_id == grp)
    current_family <- unique(grp_df$og_family)
    current_analysis <- unique(grp_df$analysis_type)
    
    #list files being included
    cat("Source files:", nrow(grp_df), "\n")
    
    # Load and stack all rasters for this specific family/analysis combo
    family_rasters <- lapply(grp_df$full_path, rast)
    raster_stack <- rast(family_rasters)
    print(raster_stack)
    
    # Sum across layers
    summed <- app(raster_stack, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Apply terrestrial mask (NO Antarctica) if applicable
    if (current_analysis == "terrestrial" && current_family %in% families_no_ant) {
      cat("Applying Antarctica mask\n")
      summed <- mask(summed, land_no_ant)
    } 
    

    out_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(grp, ".tif"))
    writeRaster(summed, out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
    cat("Saved:", basename(out_path), "\n")
  }
  
  cat("\nCompleted", toupper(proj), ":", processed_count, "groups processed.\n")
}



```
